notes: Two of the three rooms are melee combat — skeletons then a boss arena — so Action leads and its Hack & Slash preset fits exactly: the genre notes call out that a linear room-to-room run is rooms-sequence and the seal-behind-you fight is arena-lockin. Puzzle is named as secondary because Room 2 is a real pressure-plate-and-iron-gate puzzle rather than flavour, and it contributes button-solve for the floor plates and gate-solve for the iron gate they open. Dropped the preset's destructible-cluster since the prompt enumerates each room's contents and never asks for breakable geometry, and stayed on P0 because rooms-sequence carries no modifier and the whole map is inside the dungeon, so there is no outside-to-inside transition to route P3. Without a user I took the answers' word that the run ends at the giant chest in the boss hall; no loaded option expresses a treasure payoff, so the chest and its gold coins need to survive as the placed end-of-run reward.
